subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the slash-command prompt metadata gap, or should it also sponsor a broader channel-selective reply-routing API?
rationale: Source inspection shows a narrow fixable gap in /context and /export-session prompt reconstruction, but the original selective-reply request changes delivery policy and the issue carries needs-product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals.

options.title: Narrow to command metadata
options.body: Fix resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle so reconstructed command prompts include channel, capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and action guidance, while leaving delivery policy unchanged.

options.title: Sponsor routing API work
options.body: Keep this issue as a broader product item for explicit channel-selective reply controls and require an owner-approved API/design before implementation.

options.title: Split the asks
options.body: Open or link a separate follow-up for selective delivery and keep this issue focused on the source-confirmed prompt metadata gap.

recommendation.title: Narrow to command metadata
recommendation.body: Fix resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle so reconstructed command prompts include channel, capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and action guidance, while leaving delivery policy unchanged.
